name: 49456 · Spring Lake, MI
findings: ZIP 49456 (Spring Lake) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49456 (Spring Lake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
